page: Microsoft Azure E96-48ads_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the Eadv6 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor, paired with 672.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a high memory-to-core ratio of 14.0 GB per vCPU, positioning the instance within the memory-optimized category.

The server includes 5669 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, providing high-capacity local disk space directly attached to the instance. It is also premium storage capable for external disk configurations. There are no graphics processing units integrated into this server type, meaning all computational tasks rely entirely on the AMD CPU cores.

The high memory density relative to the virtual CPU count makes this server type a resource-efficient option for workloads requiring large in-memory datasets without needing a proportional increase in compute cores. This resource profile is suitable for memory-intensive applications, large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, and data analytics pipelines that benefit from substantial local NVMe storage.
